svg.title: How GEAR learns a waypoint update
svg.desc: The camera image, goal and current path feed a navigation VLA. Its predicted waypoint updates move the path. During training, the energy oracle supplies local targets from scene geometry. The correction loss sends a gradient back to the model. The robot repeats bounded model updates.
